'''Jerry Jensen''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Rogue 16 from Boise, Id. His slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" />

== Service ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Dates !! Service
|-
| August 1999 – January 2001
| [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]] Rogue 16, Endor region; Boise , ID<ref name="decsq-endor">[http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/regions/endor.html Star Wars CCG Squadrons: Endor], decipher.com (listings August 1999 – January 2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010115095500/http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/regions/endor.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sm-fan">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Squadron Members], geocities.ws/plarathas (Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009142705/https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Internet Archive]</ref>
|}

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support).

== Card credits ==
Jerry Jensen is credited with the original concept of one Players Committee [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]].<ref name="cardlabels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The concept credit names where the concept was won: PC Volunteer Award 2005. The card is in [[Virtual Block 3]] (cards first released 2002–2009).

{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Card !! Set !! Released !! Credit as printed
|-
| [[Lord Vader (V)|•Lord Vader (V)]] || [[Virtual Block 3]] || 2002–2009 || "Original concept by Jerry Jensen, PC Volunteer Award 2005"
|}

The same credits are listed under [[Card Credits#Jerry Jensen|Jerry Jensen]] on [[Card Credits]].
